title: EventApp.lv
description: An event discovery platform for Latvia covering concerts, theatre, festivals, and exhibitions. It aggregates events from public sources, links to official organizers and ticket sellers, supports collaborative planning, and offers personalized subscriptions.
highlights: Engineered advanced event discovery with intelligent filtering across 25+ categories
Built collaborative event planning with secure shareable links
Developed an organizer dashboard with real-time analytics and performance insights
Optimized performance to achieve sub-second page loads using SSR and edge caching

title: BalticGP
description: A motorcycle road racing calendar for the Baltics and Europe. It helps riders and fans quickly find official races, trainings, and track days in one reliable place.
highlights: Unified official race and training schedules across multiple organizers
Fast filters for tracks, countries, event types, and championships
Transparent review flow for contributed events before publication
Reliable event pages with source links and last-updated timestamps
